mara.name: Mara
mara.line: Keep your hands where I can see them. Crowns speak clearer than promises.

brann.name: Brann
brann.line: The bell broke. My anvil did not. Bring iron and I will make you dangerous.

sister.name: Sister Elowen
sister.line: Sit. Your wounds are honest, even if your memories are not.

tovin.name: Tovin
tovin.line: Something wore my brother’s face in the woods. Please find his charm.

ilya.name: Captain Ilya
ilya.line: The crypt gate needs a sigil. The forest sentinel carries it. End the bell’s silence.

osric.name: Osric
osric.line: The Veil is a mercy! Or perhaps... I need it to be.

vesper.name: Vesper
vesper.line: You have been here before. Ask the shrine what you chose to forget.

nell.name: Nell
nell.line: Beds cost coin. Rumors cost courage. The hounds fear fire.
